name: Nigeria

flag.description: Three vertical stripes of green, white and green.
flag.symbolism: Green represents the country's forests and agriculture, and white peace and unity.

hook: Nigeria is just green-white-green standing upright, no emblem at all: green farmland on both sides of a white road of peace.
trivia: The flag was designed in 1958 by Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi, a student in London; his original entry had a red sun, which the judges removed.
Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa.
